summary: Independent review of 3 migrations. VERDICT 20260713000001_CreateOperationalListItems: PASS -- tenant-scoped table with RLS (ENABLE+FORCE), tenant-scoped policy via private_get_tenant_id() matching repo convention, unique partial index on (tenant_id,kind,slug) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL, idempotent CREATE IF NOT EXISTS DDL, idempotent per-tenant seed bootstrap via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING sourced from the same canonical OPERATIONAL_LIST_DEFAULTS used by the app bootstrap path (no duplicate source of truth), down() drops the table (expected/acceptable for a CREATE migration). VERDICT 20260719000017_RebuildInventoryItemsInCanonicalFormOrder: PASS -- follows the repo's established, previously-reviewed RebuildXInCanonicalFormOrder pattern (create-copy-validate-count-swap-drop), no column removal, no DROP CASCADE, row-count integrity check with abort-on-mismatch in both up() and down(), RLS re-created (ENABLE+FORCE+policy) matching convention, existing migration-structure test spec passes assertions on ordering/RLS/no-CASCADE, transaction:'each' in the migration runner makes each migration atomically retryable, registration position in ALL_MIGRATIONS is chronologically correct. One LOW finding filed (find-ee66dd07): the table rebuild grants only musicos_migrator, not musicos_app, directly -- transiently covered by the later-registered 20260802000001_GrantMusicosAppOnAllTables (retroactive grant + ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES) which runs after it in the same array, so no permanent gap, only a possible transient permission-denied window if app traffic is served mid-migration-batch. VERDICT 20260713000002_DropOrphanContactsSatelliteTables (unregistered, pending authorization): the DROP ordering (children before parent), IF EXISTS guards, and down() reconstruction (full schema+RLS+policy+grants restore) are structurally correct and safe IF the 0-rows premise holds. However the header's 0-rows-in-every-tenant claim is STALE and must not be treated as current authorization -- see HIGH finding find-4c952c9a: commit 40ddeb7a (2026-08-01) wired seeds/03_operational_seed.ts into the standard seed runner, and that seed inserts one deterministic row into contacts and one into contact_timeline for the demo tenant, postdating the header's stated verification. Correctly kept unregistered pending explicit authorization; recommend a fresh per-tenant SQL row-count re-check immediately before any future registration/execution, not reliance on the stale header claim. No RLS/tenant-isolation gaps found in any of the 3 files; no destructive migration is currently registered to run.
